title: Configuring the ROS 2 environment
keywords: environment setup source setup_bash ros_distro ros_domain_id rmw_implementation printenv shell terminal terminals see each other
text: Every shell must source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash (and the install/setup.bash of any workspace) before using ros2. The variables that decide who talks to whom are ROS_DOMAIN_ID (0 to 101 is safe on every platform), ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE, ROS_STATIC_PEERS and RMW_IMPLEMENTATION. Two terminals that see different topics usually differ in one of them: compare with printenv | grep -i ros.
